svg.title: Siltbank Shallows — Fishing piers across three freshwater sandbars
svg.desc: Three dry sandbars split the skitter pockets. A sample hut, fishing crates and two low bridges introduce loops; a high bank walk reaches every runnel safely.
svg.text: Fishing piers across three freshwater sandbars
Three dry sandbars split the skitter pockets. A sample hut, fishing crates and two low bridges introduce loops; a high
bank walk reaches every runnel safely.
